title: KNOCK -- deep knocking sound with per-hit variation

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Turn audio on with the speaker button under output.
velocity: enter or drag a value (0-127) -- each new value plays a knock at that loudness.
Harder hits are also slightly brighter.
hit: plays a knock again at the last velocity.
randomness (0-1): 0 = every knock identical; higher = more varied length, sweep and click.
bassiness (0-1): low = dry, higher tap; high = deep, long, darker boom.
output: master level fader with meter.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: Each hit sends a click~ impulse into one gen~ codebox; velocity is set just before it.
The knock is a pitch-swept sine, a damped body tone at 2.7x its pitch, and a filtered noise click.
Random offsets are drawn once per hit and scaled by randomness; the base pitch never varies.
Four voices take turns, so earlier knocks ring out when you retrigger.
